text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The number of listed companies on the Shanghai stock exchange hit 300 on Wednesday with the listing of Shandong Lukang Pharmaceutical Co Ltd.
- Deputy finance minister Liu Jibing said the aim for this year's state debt issue is to reform the state debt market and meet the increasing demand from retail investors.
- Shanghai to quicken the pace of reforming state-owned enterprises with a new shareholding system for the enterprises to be established by the end of this year.
- Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets rose slightly on Wednesday on the back of good performance by three newly-listed companies.
- BUSINESS NEWS - A group of Shanghai journalists will leave on Thursday for a 12-day visit to Taiwan.
- Pudong's Jinqiao Export Processing Zone had attracted 302 foreign-invested projects by the end of 1996.
